completion_scope: six fixed affine first2 gas transactions, continuous coefficient defect; independent review in paired artifact

nodes.question: Can a first coefficient-variation correction with exact frozen damping recover the observed number and heat defects at lower cost, and provide a useful separate continuum error diagnostic?
fixed_inputs: saved E13C2 full and six-local continuous references
nodes.minimal_action: derive e1 and moment remainder from THEORY; implement for the same six local controls with existing event masks and source law; compare against saved oracle without rerunning it
nodes.candidate_method: e1=G_f*e_a + convolution(G_f,delta_q-delta_Lambda*P_f); weighted direct term plus frozen-opacity field response; retain source/redshift/seam terms

research_diagnostic_acceptance.claim: candidate approximation only, not physical accuracy admission
research_diagnostic_acceptance.near_zero_policy: use declared absolute arithmetic floor and label unresolved relative error; never divide by a near-zero defect

nodes.expand_only_if: local implementation and identities pass; then evaluate current first2 path correction against existing saved E13C2 reference, with no new gas advance
nodes.rigorous_bound_claim_requires: outward coefficient/integral enclosures for D_Lambda and B_r plus weighted remainder and anchor/outflow terms
stop_conditions: first sign/ledger/domain failure preserved and classified
unsupported nonzero outflow -> explicit scoped stop
candidate misses1percent diagnostic -> report failure, no post-hoc tolerance relaxation
nodes.carried_incoming_defect_bound: for nonzero e_a, sup|e-e1| <= D_Lambda*(|e_a|+B_r); include incoming correction and its uncertainty, not the e_a=0-only bound

nodes.action: resolve the parallel PHOTON_HEATING draft actual input identity before any computation

provider-bound photon spectrum, heat and recoil moments required separately
